thread:
Jen: Quick update — two small personal wins: promoted to Senior Staff (official today 🎉) and we're expecting a baby in September! Wanted to share here. :)

Kai: wow congrats x2!!! :party_parrot: :tada:

Asha: This is amazing, Jen!! When's the bump due? We'll need a cake and a tiny onesie for the office plants 🌱

Jen: thanks!! due Sept 10. cake definitely please. also my new title feels real because I can change my email sig now 😂

People Ops Bot: Happy milestone, Jen! We'll add a celebration to the calendar. Please fill this short google form so we can order a cake and a gift: <https://forms.goo.gl/example>

Maya: link plz — also what flavor? chocolate > everything :chocolate_bar:

Lina: vanilla is underrated :vanilla:

Tom: Vote imo: chocolate w/ salted caramel drizzle :yum:

Asha: Can we do a small lunchtime gathering on Tue? Zoom link for remote folks pls.

People Ops Bot: Created event 'Jen: Promotion + Baby Congrats' Tue 12:30pm PDT — Zoom + in-person. RSVP here: <https://calendar.example.com/event/jen-congrats>

Kai: :raised_hands: i'll bring streamers. congrats again!!!

Jen: I'm so touched — thanks everyone. No pressure on gifts, your presence is enough. Registry link if anyone asks: <https://registry.example.com/jen>

Lina: Noted. Also — is it okay to hang a 'Congrats Jen' banner in front of her desk? :)

Jen: yes please! tiny banner pls, not a parade lol.

Tom: :thumbsup: I'll handle banner printing. Also adding a few baby onesies to the office plant. — reacted with :heart:
